content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record states the claims and the final conclusion of no discrimination, but it contains no evidence about the selections (selecting official, qualifications, reasons) and no reasoning linking any evidence to the conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Some statements are tied to the ROI (e.g., ROI at 238, 61 for the harassment report), but the non-selection characterizations and the Agency's conclusion are not attributed to any identified source."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Dates are given for the March 25, 2022 incident, the May 2, 2022 non-selections, the May 3 and June 29, 2022 complaint filings, but the sequence is muddled (complaint initiated May 3 and filed June 29), the prior EEO activity is undated, and the dates of the ROI, hearing notice, and final decision are missing."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who decided the selections or the final decision, what criteria or framework was applied, or whether any responsive or mitigating information was considered before finalizing."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"The record cannot stand alone because it lacks the selection evidence, decision-maker explanations, and analytic steps, so an independent reviewer could not assess whether the no-discrimination conclusion is supported."}}}
